_comment: Allowlist anti-slopsquatting (check-deps.mjs). Toda dep nova exige adicao EXPLICITA aqui apos verificar que e legitima.

_justifications.@msgpack/msgpack: Official MessagePack JavaScript implementation (msgpack/msgpack-javascript, ISC), required by Fal's documented specialized realtime protocol. Version 3.1.3 name, repository, license and SHA-512 tarball integrity verified against the npm registry on 2026-11-03 for PR #18849; no additional runtime dependency is introduced by this correction.
_justifications.@agentclientprotocol/sdk: Official Agent Client Protocol TypeScript SDK (agentclientprotocol/typescript-sdk, Apache-2.0). Exact 1.4.0 registry tarball and integrity verified for the registered native Gemini ACP launcher.
_justifications.@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono: Self-hosted Keak type ramp for the vendored CI UI Kit (fontsource, OFL fonts; same no-CDN reasoning as Material Symbols #3695). KEA-7886 — CI UI Kit runtime dependency.
_justifications.@fontsource/instrument-serif: Self-hosted Keak type ramp for the vendored CI UI Kit (fontsource, OFL fonts; same no-CDN reasoning as Material Symbols #3695). KEA-7886 — CI UI Kit runtime dependency.
_justifications.@fontsource/inter: Self-hosted Keak type ramp for the vendored CI UI Kit (fontsource, OFL fonts; same no-CDN reasoning as Material Symbols #3695). KEA-7886 — CI UI Kit runtime dependency.
_justifications.@fontsource/vazirmatn: Self-hosted Vazirmatn (rastikerdar/vazirmatn via fontsource, OFL-1.1) for the Arabic-script RTL locales fa/ar/ur; same fontsource publisher and no-CDN reasoning (#3695) as the Keak fonts. Exact 5.3.0 tarball integrity verified; only named under html[dir=rtl] so LTR pages never download it.
_justifications.@opencode/plugin: Stable OpenCode 2.x plugin contract (npm maintainer thdxr = OpenCode author; successor of the beta @opencode-ai/plugin). Dev + peer dep of @omniroute/opencode-plugin-v2, added by PR #14370 without an allowlist entry; verified on npm 2026-09-23. Refs #14496.
_justifications.@radix-ui/react-dialog: Radix primitive required by packages/ui-kit (already transitive via fumadocs-ui, pinned at the versions in the base tree). KEA-7886 — CI UI Kit runtime dependency.
_justifications.@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu: Radix primitive required by packages/ui-kit (already transitive via fumadocs-ui, pinned at the versions in the base tree). KEA-7886 — CI UI Kit runtime dependency.
_justifications.@radix-ui/react-hover-card: Radix primitive required by packages/ui-kit since kit 0.0.86 (HoverCard, upstream keak-ai/cheaper-inference-ui-kit#123; radix-ui/primitives, MIT), pinned exactly like the other Radix packages. KEA-7886 — CI UI Kit runtime dependency.
_justifications.@radix-ui/react-popover: Radix primitive required by packages/ui-kit (already transitive via fumadocs-ui, pinned at the versions in the base tree). KEA-7886 — CI UI Kit runtime dependency.
_justifications.@radix-ui/react-select: Radix primitive required by packages/ui-kit (already transitive via fumadocs-ui, pinned at the versions in the base tree). KEA-7886 — CI UI Kit runtime dependency.

_justifications.@testing-library/dom: Peer dep obrigatoria de @testing-library/react v16 (adicionada no PR #11224); Refs #9985.
_justifications.@testing-library/user-event: Utilitario oficial do ecossistema testing-library para testes de UI (adicionada no PR #11224); Refs #9985.
_justifications.babel-plugin-react-compiler: Official React Compiler Babel plugin (facebook/react, MIT). Required peer of Next.js 16 `reactCompiler: true`; Next declares it optional (`*`) and does not auto-install. Added by PR #11783 / issue #67.
_justifications.eslint-plugin-react-hooks: React Hooks lint rules (set-state-in-effect, immutability, refs, purity) pinned at 7.0.1 by the release/v3.8.51 cycle; the 224 findings it raised are tracked in #11924. Refs #11924.
_justifications.intl-messageformat: FormatJS ICU MessageFormat compiler (formatjs/formatjs, BSD-3-Clause), already a transitive dependency of next-intl. Pinned 11.2.14 as a direct devDependency so check:ui-icu compiles every UI catalog with the same engine the app uses (PR #15912, refs #12560).
_justifications.istanbul-lib-instrument: Official IstanbulJS original-source instrumenter, pinned at 6.0.3 (BSD-3-Clause). npm provenance checked on 2026-09-22: repository istanbuljs/istanbuljs, package created 2015-11-21. Common Node/Vitest coverage instrumentation with real parity regression; review in PR #14524. Does not change coverage floors or activate rollout.
_justifications.qrcode: QR code generator (soldair/node-qrcode, MIT), exact 1.5.4. Renders the otpauth:// enrollment QR server-side for opt-in dashboard TOTP two-factor login; owner-approved dependency for the port of upstream PR 4144. @types/qrcode 1.5.6 (DefinitelyTyped, MIT) is its typing devDependency.
_justifications.@types/qrcode: DefinitelyTyped typings for qrcode (MIT), exact 1.5.6, devDependency paired with qrcode.
_justifications.react-day-picker: DayPicker 10.0.1 required by packages/ui-kit's calendar. KEA-7886 — CI UI Kit runtime dependency.
_justifications.harfbuzzjs: devDependency used only by scripts/docs/readme-outline.mjs to shape the kit's Switzer text roles and turn them into vector outlines for the README SVGs (the font's licence forbids embedding a subset). MIT; HarfBuzz compiled to WASM, no native build, no network at runtime. Already in the tree through subset-font; pinned exact at 1.6.4.
_justifications.fontverter: devDependency used only by scripts/docs/readme-outline.mjs to read the vendored Switzer woff2 into memory as sfnt for HarfBuzz; nothing it converts is ever written or embedded. BSD-3-Clause; maintained by papandreou (assetgraph). Already in the tree through subset-font; pinned exact at 2.0.0.
_justifications.subset-font: devDependency used only by scripts/docs/readme-fonts.mjs to subset the OFL IBM Plex Mono @fontsource woff2 to the code characters each README SVG keeps as real text, embedded as a data: URI that renders inside GitHub's sandbox. BSD-3-Clause; HarfBuzz compiled to WASM (harfbuzzjs, MIT), no native build, no network at runtime. Maintained by papandreou (assetgraph), 2.x line since 2022.
_justifications.adm-zip: Required managed-proxy ZIP reader for verified Windows core archives (PR #16457). npm registry identity and repository verified on 2026-11-11: adm-zip 0.6.1, cthackers/adm-zip, maintainer cthackers. Already pinned by the lockfile and overrides; this records the existing runtime dependency, with archive traversal, symlink and size-limit regressions retained.
_justifications.tar: Required managed-proxy tar reader for verified Unix core archives (PR #16457). npm registry identity and repository verified on 2026-11-11: tar 7.5.21, isaacs/node-tar, maintainer isaacs. Already pinned by the lockfile and overrides; this records the existing runtime dependency, with archive traversal, symlink and size-limit regressions retained.
